notes.title: Bug corrections, Dutch version and DLC ready!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088149/f1e3b24cfa8bb7f57f2ce07bfa2d75d230ad71db.png[/img]

[b]1.0.4 update log:[/b]

- Bug corrections (the ending puzzle is fixed, among other minor things)
- The game is now ready to welcome the incoming DLC.

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Three new languages!
notes.content:
Hi there!

Here is finally the update you've been waiting for, The World After now features Simplified Chinese, Italian and Russian as game texts and subtitles options.

We also corrected a few minor bugs that you told us about.

So thank you so much for your support and your feedbacks, it has been two very busy weeks for our team but we are very grateful to our community for their help.

Coming next :
- texts and subtitles will soon be available in Dutch, Korean and Japanese.
- the free retro-filter DLC is also due in a couple of weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088149/6d0454c5b231a970dbd14985d710d0ef6ad68a0d.png[/img]
Why making a retro-style DLC when you can make two?
We are thinking about making a NES-style demake of our bonus visual novel, what would you think about it?

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - macOS Big Sur support - new languages announcements
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Good news : we finally made our game compatible with macOS Big Sur. Once again, we're deeply sorry for the inconvenience.

[b]However, we weren't able to test it on an Apple Silicon / M1 computer, so please if you encounter any more problems, feel free to contact us. People tested [/b]

The bad news : Windows 7 will never be able to run our game correctly, due to the lack of support of modern video codecs on this OS. We're very sorry, there is nothing we can do about that.

Other update notes :
- we changed the whole audio manager
- we deleted the ghost image that sometimes appears after opening the suitcase.
- the loading screen is now scaling with the screen resolution

In a near future, we will add new languages as subtitles :
- simplified chinese
- russian
- italian

And in a second time :
- japanese
- korean

Thank you so much for your patience and your support.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
We have a first update!

Some people told us they had trouble running the game on Windows 7. We tried to add a patch for that in this version, but with no means to test it yet we don't know for sure if it works.
Please tell us if you are having trouble on Windows 7.

A few sound improvements (specially on the French version and on sound design) were made.
A few bugs were corrected (weird hitboxes and fade outs at some places in the game)
A few subtitles were corrected as well.

Thank you so much for your support and your feedbacks.
